summary: The Phase 3 Voice Pipeline PRD appears to have been fully implemented based on commit history on the main branch (bot.py, call_state.py, voice.py, 22 tests, state machine, Redis streams), but the branch under review — feat/voice-pipeline-fixes — is 7 commits behind and 0 commits ahead with zero file changes. This means the session produced no verifiable work on this branch. The commits listed in the session log (latency optimizations, RAG hardening, Phase 6 audit, Phase 1 docs) are all post-Phas

The branch contains only 9 commits loosely related to Phase 1 foundations and documentation, zero commits delivering the core Phase 03-04 voice pipeline artifacts (bot.py, call_state.py, voice.py router, or required tests). Instead, 4 commits introduce severe scope creep...
